text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During one of Mejiro Bright's dance
lessons...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you be willing to observe
my
dance sequence for a new piece of
music?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This will be my first time doing the
whole song in
one go, so I'd like to hear
your opinion on the
performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Many thanks. Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Left, right, one, two! Sliiide,
jump! Sliiide
and
jump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright has all the moves
memorized, and
yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's moving at half the speed of the
song!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems I've fallen behind
tempo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How would you suggest I remain in time
with the
rhythm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh. That way, I could synchronize with
my
dance partner instead. What a
promising idea.
choice_data_list: Why not try dancing with a partner?
For now, let's perfect it at this ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, who shall I ask to join me for a
practice
session?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, yes. Dober is practicing this very
song as
well. I shall invite her at once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll lead, so try to keep up with
me, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
By all means, Dober. I look forward to
dancing
with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's begin. Three, two, one, go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first verse goes pretty well, but
Mejiro
Dober's movements gradually
start slowing
down...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's like she's stuck in slo-mo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? How strange... Somehow, I can't
help but
match Bright's movements...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This might be too great an ask for me
alone. Wait
a moment, please. I'll go and
fetch Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm so very grateful for your
assistance in
this
endeavor, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it, Bright! I can do this all
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eyes on me, guys! I'll keep us on the
beat! Ready,
hit it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's steps are full of energy! Mostly?
...Kinda?
...A liiittle?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: H-hold up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Mejiro Bright's take-it-slow
energy is
infectious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A fine suggestion, indeed. I can simply
increase
the tempo later on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now then, once more from the top.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Left, right, one, two! Sliiide,
jump! Sliiide
and
jump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Was this song always so relaxing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At some point while watching Mejiro
Bright's
laid-back dance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? Oh, Trainer? ♪
choice_data_list: (My head is starting to feel hazy...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My curfew draws near, so I'd like to
conclude
today's lesson shortly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Glancing around, I see that night has
fallen
without my realizing it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Bright's take-it-slow
dancing style
makes you lose track of
time...
